title: The crane and the four little chicks
description: A white Siberian Crane and four small yellow chicks flying to the left over two hills, with a compass card in the top right corner.

title: Lali faces the rising Sun
description: A girl seen from above facing the rising Sun on the right, with her arms stretched up and down the frame and the four directions marked around her.

title: A playground with a compass
description: A playground with a swing, a slide, a sandpit and a seesaw in a two by two pattern, four arrows labelled east, south, west and north, and a compass card.

title: A room plan with the girl at the centre
description: A square room plan from above with a girl at the centre, a table above her, a bed on the right, a cupboard on the left and a door below, with four direction arrows and a compass card.

title: North and south on a street map
labels: North of the court: the pond block
South of the court: the Shopping Centre
description: A small street map in three bands: the pond block with Jaideep's House at the top, the Basketball Court in the middle, Market Road and the Shopping Centre at the bottom, with a compass and three tags.

title: A cycle and two left turns
labels: A cycle and two left turns
description: An upside down U shaped road seen from above with a cycle driving north, then west after the first left turn, then south after the second left turn, and a compass.

title: Where two metro lines meet
labels: A part of the metro map
description: A yellow line and a magenta line crossing at a capsule labelled Hauz Khas, with a key that shows a plain circle as Metro Station and a capsule as Interchange Line.

title: Counting stations between
labels: 4 + 1 + 6 = 11 stations between Hauz Khas and Badarpur
description: A strip of the metro map from Hauz Khas along the magenta line past 4 circles to the Kalkaji Mandir capsule, then along the violet line past 6 circles to Badarpur, with the count 4 + 1 + 6 = 11.

topic_name: Making a Map with a Key
title: A library corner and its key
labels: A library corner seen from above
description: A plan of a library corner with 2 shelves, a table with 4 chairs, a door and a red dot under the table, next to a key that explains each symbol, with a compass.

topic_name: Distance and Direction on a Grid
title: The ant on the grid
labels: Berry: 2 cm towards the east, then 4 cm towards the north
description: A grid of 1 cm squares with an ant at its anthill, a leaf 4 cm to the west, a seed 6 cm to the south and a berry reached by 2 cm to the east and then 4 cm to the north.

topic_name: Distance and Direction on a Grid
title: Three routes to the berry
labels: 5 cm east, then 3 cm north, then 1 cm west
description: Three grids with an ant and a berry, showing Route 1 (4 cm east then 3 cm north, 7 cm), Route 2 (3 cm north then 4 cm east, 7 cm) and Route 3 (5 cm east, 3 cm north, 1 cm west, 9 cm).

title: Where is the giraffe?
description: A 12 by 12 grid with numbered lines, a teal arrow 8 steps east along the bottom, a green arrow 9 steps north up to the giraffe, and the position (8,9) with column and row named.

title: Is the giraffe at (9,8)?
labels: The first number is the column. The second number is the row.
description: A 12 by 12 grid with the giraffe at (8,9) and a red dot at (9,8), each joined by dashed lines to its column and row numbers, and two boxes saying 8 steps east then 9 north and 9 steps east then 8 north.

title: The trip board
labels: From the bed, she is west
description: A board of 9 small cards in 3 rows, one simple picture for each idea of the chapter from directions by the Sun to the position of a place on a grid.
